review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean flags, empty fields, Prismatic shader metadata, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise idiomatic Greek, source humor and wordplay, correct material/color details, established Calico Desert and prismatic terminology, and the project's stable Σκαφίδι term.
